definitions.explanation: The part of the body between the chest and the pelvis. A formal or medical term for the stomach/belly area.

examples.japanese: {腹部|ふくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel pain in my abdomen.

examples.japanese: {腹部|ふくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧エコー⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had an abdominal ultrasound examination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{腹部|ふくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: He was taken to the hospital after hitting his abdomen hard in an accident.

notes:
Compound of {腹|ふく} (belly, abdomen) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part, region). A formal and medical term for the belly area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腹部|ふくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: abdominal pain
- {腹部|ふくぶ}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: abdominal examination
- {腹部|ふくぶ}エコー: abdominal ultrasound
- {腹部|ふくぶ}CT: abdominal CT scan
- {腹部|ふくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}す→刺す：02111_sasu⟧: to stab the abdomen

REGISTER:
Primarily used in medical, formal, and written contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧ (tummy, stomach area) or ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ (belly) would be more natural.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{胸部|きょうぶ}→胸部：27436_kyoubu⟧: chest area
- {背部|はいぶ}: back area
- {下腹部|かふくぶ}: lower abdomen
